data.narrative: The student applied context engineering with strong execution discipline by building layered-surgical context packages, producing three first-pass artifacts, and then validating convention fit against repository evidence. They identified a concrete convention drift in error-status assumptions, traced it to missing explicit error-contract context, and confirmed improvement through a targeted rerun. Their reasoning stayed evidence-first throughout BUILD, VERIFY, BREAK, and FIX, with clear separation between observed behavior and assumptions.
